    EXP-C2 & sensitivity & M5 & M7 & paired t-test & 5 & n is the number of cross-validation folds, one paired observation each & 0.491 & 0.457 & 0.0340 & 1.150 & 0.3143 & 1.0000 & 0.5682 & Cohen d (paired) & 0.514 & True & UNDERPOWERED, NOT NEGATIVE. paired t-test on n=5 cannot produce a p-value below 0.0625 however large the effect, so failing to reject says nothing about M5 versus M7. The observed gap is 0.0340 in favour of M5. \\
    EXP-C2 & sensitivity & M6 & M7 & Wilcoxon signed-rank & 5 & n is the number of cross-validation folds, one paired observation each & 0.457 & 0.457 & 0.0000 & n/a & 1.0000 & 1.0000 & 1.0000 & rank-biserial correlation & 0.000 & True & UNDERPOWERED, NOT NEGATIVE. Wilcoxon signed-rank on n=5 cannot produce a p-value below 0.0625 however large the effect, so failing to reject says nothing about M6 versus M7. The observed gap is 0.0000 in favour of neither. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
  \par\footnotesize EVERY p-VALUE STATES ITS n, AND n IS THE NUMBER OF FOLDS. The repeated 5x5 binary map gives n=25. EXP-B2 is a plain 5-fold map, so n=5 there, and a two-sided Wilcoxon on five pairs cannot go below 0.0625 however large the effect. The 'Underpowered' column marks exactly those rows: a non-significant result there is a statement about the design, not about the models.
  \par\footnotesize AN EFFECT SIZE ACCOMPANIES EVERY p-VALUE. A significant result on 25 folds can sit on a 0.001 difference; the effect size is what stops that being written up as a finding.
  \par\footnotesize TWO CORRECTIONS, BOTH REPORTED. Holm controls the family-wise error rate and is the conservative choice for a claim about one pair; Benjamini-Hochberg controls the false discovery rate and is the right one for screening many pairs. The family is one (run, metric) group -- correcting across metrics would treat sensitivity and specificity on the same folds as independent tests.
  \par\footnotesize Fold-level tests use folds as the unit of observation. Record-level tests (McNemar, the AUC bootstrap) run on ONE repeat of the map, which is a complete partition of the corpus; pooling all 25 folds would put every record in the sample five times.
  \par\footnotesize PV-MEPCG / PulseVision is an academic screening and decision-support prototype, not a diagnostic tool.
\end{table}
